<style>
  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  <section id="projects">

    <div class="project-card">
      <div class="project-header">
        <span class="project-title">Human vs AI Art Perception — Replication Analysis</span>
        <span class="project-term">Spring 2026</span>
      </div>
      <a class="gh-link" href="https://github.com/meganajoseph/AI_sentiments"><i class="ti ti-brand-github"></i> View on GitHub</a>
      <p class="project-desc">
        Wrangled a 60-participant × 319-column survey dataset on AI art perception from wide to long format using R tidyverse. Audited and reanalyzed the study's Friedman Test and Within-Factors Repeated Measures ANOVA, uncovering dataset mislabeling through systematic comparison of descriptive statistics with ggpubr.
      </p>
      <div class="project-tags">

        <span class="project-term">Spring 2026</span>
      </div>
      <a class="gh-link" href="https://github.com/rubertyao/NCAAWomensVolleyballAnalysis"><i class="ti ti-brand-github"></i> View on GitHub</a>
      <p class="project-desc">

      <div class="project-tags">
        <span class="tag accent">Python</span>

        <span class="project-term">Fall 2025</span>
